ck_account_system_key_fmt.name: ck_account_system_key_fmt
ck_account_system_key_fmt.value: "accounts"."system_key" is null or (char_length("accounts"."system_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 and "accounts"."system_key" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$')

ux_journal_entry_org_source.name: ux_journal_entry_org_source
ux_journal_entry_org_source.where: "journal_entries"."source_id" is not null and "journal_entries"."reversal_of_id" is null

ck_journal_entry_source.name: ck_journal_entry_source
ck_journal_entry_source.value: "journal_entries"."source_id" is null or "journal_entries"."source_type" is not null

ck_journal_entry_posted.name: ck_journal_entry_posted
ck_journal_entry_posted.value: ("journal_entries"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "journal_entries"."posted_at" is null and "journal_entries"."posted_by" is null) or ("journal_entries"."status" <> 'DRAFT' and "journal_entries"."posted_at" is not null)

ck_journal_entry_text_len.name: ck_journal_entry_text_len
ck_journal_entry_text_len.value:
("journal_entries"."description" is null or char_length("journal_entries"."description") <= 500)
                and ("journal_entries"."source_type" is null or char_length("journal_entries"."source_type") <= 40)
                and ("journal_entries"."source_ref" is null or char_length("journal_entries"."source_ref") <= 64)

ck_accounting_period_closed.name: ck_accounting_period_closed
ck_accounting_period_closed.value: ("accounting_periods"."status" = 'CLOSED' and "accounting_periods"."closed_at" is not null) or ("accounting_periods"."status" = 'OPEN' and "accounting_periods"."closed_at" is null and "accounting_periods"."closed_by" is null)

ck_batch_dates.name: ck_batch_dates
ck_batch_dates.value: "batches"."manufactured_on" is null or "batches"."expires_on" is null or "batches"."expires_on" >= "batches"."manufactured_on"

ck_batch_shelf_life_unit_and_value.name: ck_batch_shelf_life_unit_and_value
ck_batch_shelf_life_unit_and_value.value:
("batches"."shelf_life_value" is null and "batches"."shelf_life_unit" is null)
                or ("batches"."shelf_life_value" is not null and "batches"."shelf_life_unit" is not null)

ux_stock_movement_org_source.name: ux_stock_movement_org_source
ux_stock_movement_org_source.where: "stock_movements"."source_id" is not null and "stock_movements"."reversal_of_id" is null

ck_stock_movement_source.name: ck_stock_movement_source
ck_stock_movement_source.value: "stock_movements"."source_id" is null or "stock_movements"."source_type" is not null

ck_stock_movement_text_len.name: ck_stock_movement_text_len
ck_stock_movement_text_len.value:
("stock_movements"."source_type" is null or char_length("stock_movements"."source_type") <= 40)
                and ("stock_movements"."source_ref" is null or char_length("stock_movements"."source_ref") <= 64)
                and ("stock_movements"."note" is null or char_length("stock_movements"."note") <= 500)

ck_inventory_reservation_closed_at.name: ck_inventory_reservation_closed_at
ck_inventory_reservation_closed_at.value:
("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "inventory_reservations"."closed_at" is null)
                or ("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'CLOSED' and "inventory_reservations"."closed_at" is not null)

ux_inventory_cost_layer_org_base_batch_s.name: ux_inventory_cost_layer_org_base_batch_source
ux_inventory_cost_layer_org_base_batch_s.where: "inventory_cost_layers"."origin_cost_layer_id" is null and "inventory_cost_layers"."inventory_item_batch_id" is not null

ck_inventory_adjustment_text_len.name: ck_inventory_adjustment_text_len
ck_inventory_adjustment_text_len.value: ("inventory_adjustments"."reference_number" is null or char_length("inventory_adjustments"."reference_number") <= 64) and ("inventory_adjustments"."description" is null or char_length("inventory_adjustments"."description") <= 500)

ck_item_expiry_settings_unit_and_value.name: ck_item_expiry_settings_unit_and_value
ck_item_expiry_settings_unit_and_value.value: ("item_expiry_settings"."default_shelf_life_value" IS NULL AND "item_expiry_settings"."default_shelf_life_unit" IS NULL) OR ("item_expiry_settings"."default_shelf_life_value" IS NOT NULL AND "item_expiry_settings"."default_shelf_life_unit" IS NOT NULL)

ck_item_warehouse_setting_stock_range.name: ck_item_warehouse_setting_stock_range
ck_item_warehouse_setting_stock_range.value:
"item_warehouse_settings"."minimum_stock" IS NULL OR "item_warehouse_settings"."maximum_stock" IS NULL
                OR "item_warehouse_settings"."minimum_stock" <= "item_warehouse_settings"."maximum_stock"

ck_item_prices_non_negative.name: ck_item_prices_non_negative
ck_item_prices_non_negative.value: ("items"."cost_price" is null or "items"."cost_price" >= 0) and ("items"."selling_price" is null or "items"."selling_price" >= 0)

ck_org_state_needs_country.name: ck_org_state_needs_country
ck_org_state_needs_country.value: "organizations"."state_id" is null or "organizations"."country_code" is not null

ck_purchase_order_line_amount_max.name: ck_purchase_order_line_amount_max
ck_purchase_order_line_amount_max.value: "purchase_order_lines"."unit_price" between 0 and 999999999999999 and "purchase_order_lines"."discount_amount" between 0 and 999999999999999 and "purchase_order_lines"."line_net_amount" between 0 and 999999999999999

ck_purchase_order_line_text_len.name: ck_purchase_order_line_text_len
ck_purchase_order_line_text_len.value: ("purchase_order_lines"."notes" is null or char_length("purchase_order_lines"."notes") <= 500) and ("purchase_order_lines"."description_snapshot" is null or char_length("purchase_order_lines"."description_snapshot") <= 500)

ck_purchase_order_text_len.name: ck_purchase_order_text_len
ck_purchase_order_text_len.value: ("purchase_orders"."supplier_reference" is null or char_length("purchase_orders"."supplier_reference") <= 64) and ("purchase_orders"."notes" is null or char_length("purchase_orders"."notes") <= 1000) and ("purchase_orders"."close_reason" is null or char_length("purchase_orders"."close_reason") <= 500)

ck_purchase_order_amount_max.name: ck_purchase_order_amount_max
ck_purchase_order_amount_max.value: "purchase_orders"."subtotal_amount" between 0 and 999999999999999 and "purchase_orders"."discount_amount" between 0 and 999999999999999 and "purchase_orders"."tax_amount" between 0 and 999999999999999 and "purchase_orders"."total_amount" between 0 and 999999999999999

ck_purchase_shipment_line_text_len.name: ck_purchase_shipment_line_text_len
ck_purchase_shipment_line_text_len.value: ("purchase_shipment_lines"."notes" is null or char_length("purchase_shipment_lines"."notes") <= 500) and ("purchase_shipment_lines"."supplier_batch_ref" is null or char_length("purchase_shipment_lines"."supplier_batch_ref") <= 100)

ck_purchase_shipment_text_len.name: ck_purchase_shipment_text_len
ck_purchase_shipment_text_len.value: ("purchase_shipments"."carrier" is null or char_length("purchase_shipments"."carrier") <= 100) and ("purchase_shipments"."tracking_number" is null or char_length("purchase_shipments"."tracking_number") <= 100) and ("purchase_shipments"."supplier_delivery_reference" is null or char_length("purchase_shipments"."supplier_delivery_reference") <= 100) and ("purchase_shipments"."void_reason" is null or char_length("purchase_shipments"."void_reason") <= 500)

ck_purchase_receipt_line_qty.name: ck_purchase_receipt_line_qty
ck_purchase_receipt_line_qty.value: "purchase_receipt_lines"."received_qty" > 0 and "purchase_receipt_lines"."accepted_qty" >= 0 and "purchase_receipt_lines"."rejected_qty" >= 0 and "purchase_receipt_lines"."received_qty" = "purchase_receipt_lines"."accepted_qty" + "purchase_receipt_lines"."rejected_qty" and "purchase_receipt_lines"."received_base_qty" > 0 and "purchase_receipt_lines"."accepted_base_qty" >= 0 and "purchase_receipt_lines"."rejected_base_qty" >= 0 and "purchase_receipt_lines"."received_base_qty" = "purchase_receipt_lines"."accepted_base_qty" + "purchase_receipt_lines"."rejected_base_qty"

ck_purchase_receipt_line_text_len.name: ck_purchase_receipt_line_text_len
ck_purchase_receipt_line_text_len.value: ("purchase_receipt_lines"."notes" is null or char_length("purchase_receipt_lines"."notes") <= 500) and ("purchase_receipt_lines"."rejection_reason" is null or char_length("purchase_receipt_lines"."rejection_reason") <= 500)

ck_purchase_receipt_text_len.name: ck_purchase_receipt_text_len
ck_purchase_receipt_text_len.value: ("purchase_receipts"."supplier_delivery_reference" is null or char_length("purchase_receipts"."supplier_delivery_reference") <= 100) and ("purchase_receipts"."notes" is null or char_length("purchase_receipts"."notes") <= 1000) and ("purchase_receipts"."reverse_reason" is null or char_length("purchase_receipts"."reverse_reason") <= 500)

users_suspension_chk.name: users_suspension_chk
users_suspension_chk.value: ("users"."status" = 'suspended' and "users"."suspended_at" is not null and "users"."suspended_reason" is not null) or ("users"."status" = 'active' and "users"."suspended_at" is null and "users"."suspended_reason" is null)

user_identifiers_type_value_chk.name: user_identifiers_type_value_chk
user_identifiers_type_value_chk.value: ("user_identifiers"."type" = 'email' and "user_identifiers"."value" ~ '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+[.][^@[:space:]]+$') or ("user_identifiers"."type" = 'phone' and "user_identifiers"."value" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{6,14}$') or ("user_identifiers"."type" = 'username' and "user_identifiers"."value" !~ '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+[.][^@[:space:]]+$' and "user_identifiers"."value" !~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{6,14}$' and "user_identifiers"."value" !~ '[[:space:]]')

ck_warehouse_location_block.name: ck_warehouse_location_block
ck_warehouse_location_block.value:
("warehouse_locations"."is_blocked" and "warehouse_locations"."blocked_reason" is not null and "warehouse_locations"."blocked_at" is not null)
                or (not "warehouse_locations"."is_blocked" and "warehouse_locations"."blocked_reason" is null and "warehouse_locations"."blocked_at" is null)

ck_warehouse_location_measures.name: ck_warehouse_location_measures
ck_warehouse_location_measures.value:
("warehouse_locations"."max_weight" is null or "warehouse_locations"."max_weight" > 0) and ("warehouse_locations"."max_volume" is null or "warehouse_locations"."max_volume" > 0)
                and ("warehouse_locations"."width" is null or "warehouse_locations"."width" > 0) and ("warehouse_locations"."height" is null or "warehouse_locations"."height" > 0)
                and ("warehouse_locations"."depth" is null or "warehouse_locations"."depth" > 0)

ck_warehouse_address_len.name: ck_warehouse_address_len
ck_warehouse_address_len.value:
("warehouses"."address_line" is null or char_length("warehouses"."address_line") <= 200)
                and ("warehouses"."city" is null or char_length("warehouses"."city") <= 100)
                and ("warehouses"."region" is null or char_length("warehouses"."region") <= 100)
                and ("warehouses"."postal_code" is null or char_length("warehouses"."postal_code") <= 20)

ck_warehouse_virtual_no_address.name: ck_warehouse_virtual_no_address
ck_warehouse_virtual_no_address.value:
"warehouses"."type" = 'physical'
                or ("warehouses"."address_line" is null and "warehouses"."city" is null and "warehouses"."region" is null
                    and "warehouses"."postal_code" is null and "warehouses"."country_code" is null)
